term57.decision: user 2026-11-06 「2」 → 「42D 단자 배치를 57D 에도 가정해 지금 바로」 · 「A · 막대 높이 키움 (권장)」 · 「±170° 유지 (권장)」 (verbatim .dev/mp18-evidence/user-decisions-mp18-cable.json)
term57.source_note: 42D layout (MP10 rebuild 2 / 3 - user photo + words, .dev/mp10-evidence/user-decisions-mp10-terminals-1030.json · user-decisions-mp10-connector-1101.json): driver seen from behind - top = motor 4-pin terminal (the motor's own 6-pin connector sits on the body face under it: 42D 29 from the front of the 40 body = 11 before the body rear, 10 high with wires, 16 wide), left = 5+2 block (EVCC EGND IN_1 H L - CAN side), right = 6 block (V+ GND COM EN STP DIR - power side), bottom = screen + buttons. Blocks and the motor terminal stick out connector_clearance 12 (motor ledger, incl. wire bend) from the driver faces over a +-11 band (MP10 pocket_half_width). Driver width = 57D frame + (42D ledger driver_width 46 - frame 42.3) = frame + 3.7 (ASSUMPTION - the 42D width was never measured either)
term57.note: ASSUMPTION until the 57D arrives (MP16 listing: frame 56.4 · body J2 76 / J3 56 · board 14.1). Orientation chosen: top (motor connector + 4-pin) = module +x = world -x for J2 (behind J2) and J3 (toward J2 inside the upper arm); the screen faces the joint axis (not reachable once assembled - set CAN id / calibrate by CAN commands or before assembly). J2: right(6, power) = world -z (bottom), left(5+2, CAN) = +z (top) · J3: right(6, power) = +z (top), left(5+2, CAN) = -z (bottom)
term57.j3_slot_ends_note: cable review R1-4: C4 also places the J3 57D driver / terminal envelopes at the belt-slot ends (module x; + = toward J2 = belt tension, MP16 slots +-2.5). Toward J3 the assumed driver (frame + 3.7) meets the MP16 J3 cap beyond -1.9 (1.3 mm3 at -2.0, 49 mm3 at -2.5 - measured 2026-11-06), so the slack end is taken at -1.5: a belt at the short end of its tolerance cannot use the full -2.5 with this driver width - re-check at the 57D measurement
